raw: {"analysis":"HJM correctly treats the deployment as irreversible and serializes the work so that independent verification (QA and Security) happens on a frozen SHA before Jane Smith's gate, with explicit offline-proof requirements and a no-retry policy for the flaky camera check that preserves CI credits. JLW has some useful specifics (SQLite cache, physical device test by a supervisor) but mishandles the irreversibility constraint by suggesting post-signing feature flags or patches, and its CI flake mitigation (one retry, then escalate) is less disciplined than HJM's manual-verification approach. HJM also properly separates the read-only DB lookup from the write service account, while JLW conflates the read-only production database with the write service account configuration.","verdict":"HJM"}
